name: Should You Refinish Before or After Painting in Redmond
title-tag: Refinish Before or After Painting? A Redmond Guide
meta-description: Paint first, refinish second, touch up the baseboards after. Why that order saves money, the baseboard exception, and how to fit both into a Redmond move-in.
post-summary: March 8, 2027 · Paint first, floors second, baseboard touch-up last — sanding dust ruins wet paint, and painters can’t work over a finish that hasn’t cured. The two real exceptions, a day-by-day sequence, and how both trades fit a Redmond closing-to-move-in window.
